t: A free, simple program for hand-drawn 2D animation.
steps: Download Pencil2D from the official site.
Ask IT to approve the install on Windows, Mac, or Linux computers.
Choose a stable release. Even-numbered releases are stability releases.
Set up a drawing tablet if you have one.
Draw a simple object in the first frame.
Add frames, turn on onion skinning, and play the result.
Export the animation as a GIF or a video.
